end.summary:
• Practised multiplying by 10 and 100 using place value and adding zeroes.
• Sameer correctly answered 36 × 100 = 3600 and 125 × 100 = 12500.
• In an estimation problem, they doubled both factors, then corrected the result by dividing 2400 by 4 to get 600.
• Teach-back was not passed; place-value position in estimation remained unclear.
end.parentNote: Sameer practised using place value to multiply by 10 and 100, and explained the zeroes method. They correctly solved 36 × 100 and 125 × 100. In the estimation question, they first doubled both numbers, then corrected the mix-up by dividing by 4 to reach 600. At home, practise a few examples where only one factor is rounded, and ask Sameer to explain which place changes.
